deadline.value: Fall applications for the MS and PhD are due December 1, 2026; spring applications are due September 1.
deadline.quote: December 1 for Fall; September 1 for Spring

also.quote: Deadlines are for both national and international applicants

gre_general.value: The program does not require the GRE, but applicants can still submit scores.
gre_general.quote: Our program does not require the GRE. However, you can still submit scores

fee_waiver.value: The department runs its own fee-waiver request for applicants, with a November 15 deadline for fall.
fee_waiver.quote: If you would like to apply for an Application Fee Waiver, the office will need a copy of your CV, Transcript(s), and Statement of Purpose combined into one PDF

also.quote: The deadline for a fall application fee waiver is November 15

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by a committee after the deadline, not by a faculty agreement first.
supervisor.quote: The committee reviews all applications after the application deadline for each admission semester

entry_route.value: Applicants can apply straight to the PhD without a master's degree.
entry_route.quote: Students can apply directly for the Ph.D. degree without already having an M.S. Degree

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

funding.value: The page does not say whether admitted PhD students are funded.

notes: The department applies the Graduate College English test rules. No separate funding rule is stated.
